import requests

def get_isoforms(acc):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json"
    r = requests.get(url)
    data = r.json()
    comments = data.get('comments', [])
    for c in comments:
        if c.get('commentType') == 'ALTERNATIVE PRODUCTS':
            return c.get('isoforms', [])
    return []

print("DIXDC1 isoforms:", get_isoforms('Q155Q3'))
print("DNAJC11 isoforms:", get_isoforms('Q9NVH1'))
